say:11:1622413009:1.source_cn: 宫廷那种地方，不光看学问，还要明白人情世故，懂察言观色。

say:12:1622413010:1.text: And Cassadee... You know how she is...
say:12:1622413010:1.source_cn: 可科丝蒂她……唉，你们也知道……

choice_prompt:13:1622413010.text: And Cassadee... You know how she is...
choice_prompt:13:1622413010.source_cn: 可科丝蒂她……唉，你们也知道……

say:14:1622413011:1.text: Riels says the same thing, but I still can't put my heart at ease.
say:14:1622413011:1.source_cn: 唉，里尔斯也常这样安慰我，可我还是放心不下……

say:15:1622413013:1.text: I'm scared she'll be taken advantage of without even knowing it. She struggles with polite small talk, let alone all those court rules and politics.
say:15:1622413013:1.source_cn: 我怕她在那种复杂的环境里吃亏。她连最基本的客套话都不会...

say:16:1622413014:1.text: No parent wants their child to feel the rain, of course.
say:16:1622413014:1.source_cn: 我理解你的担忧，父母总想为孩子挡住所有风雨。

say:17:1622413015:1.text: Still, I've had my share of learning how to survive in a place that isn't yours.
say:17:1622413015:1.source_cn: 不过，说起适应新环境这件事，我倒是有些经历可以分享。

say:18:1622413016:1.text: The Serene Lyceum shelters its young. Among the Mauler clans, survival shapes every life from birth.

choice_prompt:19:1622413016.text: The Serene Lyceum shelters its young. Among the Mauler clans, survival shapes every life from birth.
choice_prompt:19:1622413016.source_cn: 在莱希拉姆，学生们往往会受到庇护，而在蛮血部落，生存会替所有人做出选择。

say:20:1622413018:1.text: When I was young, I lived among the Maulers. Clans were often at war, and the weaker ones had no choice but to keep moving.
say:20:1622413018:1.source_cn: 我年轻时生活在蛮血部落，那时候氏族之间常有战事，弱小氏...

say:21:1622413019:1.text: To cover our tracks, the elders would always set out during storms. Really fierce ones, the kind no sane person would travel in.
say:21:1622413019:1.source_cn: 而为了隐匿行踪，长辈们总会选择在风暴来临时启程，就是那...

say:22:1622413020:1.text: Oh my... Even the kids had to go? Straight through the storm?
say:22:1622413020:1.source_cn: 天哪……在天灾中迁徙，你是说，连氏族中的孩子也要穿越风暴？

say:24:1622413022:1.text: The entire clan knew braving the storm was a gamble, but it would mean a lot worse if a powerful enemy caught up to you.
say:24:1622413022:1.source_cn: 每个人都明白，穿越风暴或许能活，但若被强敌追上……等待...

say:25:1622413023:1.text: That's why the elders are always watching. <style="highlight">They care, but they don't offer shelter.</style>
say:25:1622413023:1.source_cn: 正因如此，氏族中的长者<style=highlight...

say:26:1622413024:1.text: Every storm tempers their minds. With each child who grows braver, the clan grows stronger.
say:26:1622413024:1.source_cn: 每一次穿越风暴，都磨砺着孩童们的心智。正因他们的成长，...

say:27:1622413025:1.text: But Cassadee had it easy her whole life. Her hard days were basically a bad grade. I wish I could feel better about her...
say:27:1622413025:1.source_cn: 可我对科丝蒂真的没有那么大的信心。她从小到大都顺风顺水...

say:28:1622413026:1.text: Do you really think staying at Cassadee's side every second will help her grow?
say:28:1622413026:1.source_cn: 索菲女士，你觉得，时刻守护在科丝蒂身边，真的能帮助她成长吗？

say:29:1622413027:1.text: If she's always sheltered from the wind, with the path cleared for her, when will she ever learn to fly on her own?
say:29:1622413027:1.source_cn: 如果每次风暴来临时，都有人为她撑伞、挡雨、铺平道路……...

say:30:1622413028:1.text: I think I get what you're saying.
say:30:1622413028:1.source_cn: ……我似乎，有些明白你的意思了。

say:32:1622413029:1.text: You hear Cassadee gushing about her father from the kitchen. Yeah, she's clearly proud of what will be served tonight.
say:32:1622413029:1.source_cn: 厨房里传来科丝蒂对父亲的称赞声，看来她对今晚的菜品信心十足。
say:32:1622413029:1.male: You hear Cassadee gushing about her father from the kitchen. Yeah, she's clearly proud of what will be served tonight.
say:32:1622413029:1.female: You hear Cassadee gushing about her father from the kitchen. Yeah, she's clearly proud of what will be served tonight.

say:33:1622413030:1.text: Her voice draws nearer, and with it comes a rich, tantalizing smell.
say:33:1622413030:1.source_cn: 随着她的声音由远及近，一股浓郁的烤肉香气也飘了过来。

narration:34:1622413031:1.text: Cassadee returns to the table with a huge platter of sizzling grilled meat.

say:36:1622413017:1.text: Nah, not the spooky ritual kind of thing. I mean the kind of lesson the world teaches the hard way.
say:36:1622413017:1.source_cn: 不，呵呵……倒不是那些神秘的仪式，而是实实在在的生存考验。

say:37:1622413012:1.text: Cassadee is lucky to have many looking out for her. But, still...
say:37:1622413012:1.source_cn: 嗯，科丝蒂很幸运，能碰到许多像你一样关心照顾她的人，可是……
say:37:1622413012:1.male: Cassadee is lucky to have many looking out for her. But, still...
say:37:1622413012:1.female: Cassadee is lucky to have many looking out for her. But, still...

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 我和您同样担忧这件事

choice:6:1:2.female: Why do you sound so worried?

say:1:1622414001:1.text: Oh wow... this is amazing. It smells just like a Mauler bonfire feast!
say:1:1622414001:1.source_cn: 唔……这烤肉的味道太棒了，就像蛮血部落的篝火宴一样诱人！

say:2:1622414002:1.text: Hepler looks blissed-out. This is definitely hitting the mark.
say:2:1622414002:1.source_cn: 赫普脸上带着心满意足的神态，看来这份烤肉确实合他心意。

say:4:1622414003:1.source_cn: 这可是我爸爸的拿手好菜！

choice_prompt:5:1622414003.source_cn: 这可是我爸爸的拿手好菜！

say:6:1622414004:1.text: I'm right here, in one piece! Though... it's not bad having someone worried about you. That's Solise.
say:6:1622414004:1.source_cn: 怎么会出意外，我这不是好好的？不过……有人惦记的感觉倒...
say:6:1622414004:1.male: I'm right here, in one piece! Though... it's not bad having someone worried about you. That's Solise.
say:6:1622414004:1.female: I'm right here, in one piece! Though... it's not bad having someone worried about you. That's Solise.

say:7:1622414006:1.text: What you said back in the forest, Professor Hepler—I'm still stuck on it.
say:7:1622414006:1.source_cn: 说起来，赫普老师，您先前在森林里说的那些话，我还是有些...

say:8:1622414007:1.text: Those birds are badly hurt. Without care, they can die from infection. And what if a predator finds them?
say:8:1622414007:1.source_cn: 那些候鸟伤得那么重，如果我不继续照顾它们，万一伤口感染...

say:9:1622414008:1.text: I think... it will be so cruel if we just stand there and do nothing.
say:9:1622414008:1.source_cn: 您说要停止救助，可这样……是不是太冷酷了一些？

say:10:1622414009:1.text: I know. But I still advise against it.
say:10:1622414009:1.source_cn: 是的，我不建议你再继续帮助它们。

say:12:1622414011:1.text: The best thing you can do for them is to stop here.
say:12:1622414011:1.source_cn: 如果你真的想帮助它们，恰恰需要在这个节点停手。

say:14:1622414013:1.text: Hepler takes another huge bite, then looks Cassadee in the eye.
say:14:1622414013:1.source_cn: 赫普又吞咽下一大口烤肉，认真地看着科丝蒂。

say:15:1622414014:1.text: We'll go back and check on the flock together after dinner. Some things don't land when you hear them. You need to see them.
say:15:1622414014:1.source_cn: 等吃完晚饭，我们一起再去鸟群那里看看。有些事情，光靠说...

say:16:1622414015:1.text: But for now, I'm not letting this roast go cold—this is what holidays are for.
say:16:1622414015:1.source_cn: 现在嘛，先让我好好享用这盘烤肉，这可是假期的宝藏！

narration:17:1622414016:1.male: You circle back to day-to-day life in the Serene Lyceum, with Hepler sharing a few more Mauler stories.
narration:17:1622414016:1.female: You circle back to day-to-day life in the Serene Lyceum, with Hepler sharing a few more Mauler stories.

say:20:1622414005:1.text: You're incredibly direct about it. I like it, though. Better than those high-ranking mages who talk in riddles and call it wisdom.
say:20:1622414005:1.source_cn: 提醒是好的，但你的方式可真直接。不过我倒不讨厌，总比那...

say:20:1622414005:1.female: You're incredibly direct about it. I like it, though. Better than those high-ranking mages who talk in riddles and call it wisdom.

say:0:1622415001:0.source_cn: 走吧，去看看鸟群现在怎么样了。

say:1:1622415002:0.text: I hope that everything is fine.
say:1:1622415002:0.source_cn: 嗯……希望它们都平安无事。

say:1:1622417001:1.text: Chirp-chirp! What are we waiting for, <style="highlight">Serka</style>? We're starving! That <style="highlight">human girl</style> brought fish again! Fresh catfish. Fat and juicy!

say:2:1622417002:1.text: Who cares how it got here? Just eat it while it lasts! A free dinner like this doesn't come twice!
say:2:1622417002:1.source_cn: 要我说，有吃的就赶紧吃！这么好的机会，不吃白不吃！

say:3:1622417003:1.text: Most of the flock huddle weakly behind the speaker, eyes locked on the fish. Their beaks twitch in agreement.
say:3:1622417003:1.source_cn: 多数候鸟虚弱地簇拥在这只候鸟身后，目光望向小鱼，鸟喙微...

say:4:1622417004:1.text: Chirp! <style="highlight">Bur</style>! Since when do we feed without the <style="highlight">lead bird's</style> call?

say:5:1622417005:1.text: Our ancestors have told us we migratory birds should forage for our own! Taking handouts from humans stains our dignity!
say:5:1622417005:1.source_cn: 根据先祖的规矩，我们应该自己去觅食。接受人类的施舍，这...

say:6:1622417006:1.text: A handful of sharp-eyed birds stand beside Serka, but their feathers are ragged and thin. They look half-spent already.
say:6:1622417006:1.source_cn: 少数几只眼神锐利的候鸟站在瑟卡身旁，但它们的羽毛凌乱稀...

say:7:1622417007:1.text: Talk is cheap. Point to one decent meal we've scraped together since we got here.
say:7:1622417007:1.source_cn: 说得轻巧，这几天咱们在这片森林里找到过什么像样的食物？

say:8:1622417008:1.text: Refuse it and we're done for. Just look around—everyone's barely standing.
say:8:1622417008:1.source_cn: 不吃？不吃就得饿死！你看看大伙儿！

say:9:1622417009:1.text: But... we'll lose what makes us migratory birds.
say:9:1622417009:1.source_cn: 可……这会让我们失去候鸟的尊严。

say:10:1622417010:1.text: You're the most injured, and you're asking the rest of us to die hungry with you? Absolutely not.
say:10:1622417010:1.source_cn: 你的翅膀伤得最重！然后你还要我们陪你一起饿死？凭什么！

say:11:1622417011:1.text: That's it. I'm done! Here. Take a few. We live through tonight, then we talk. Chirp-chirp!
say:11:1622417011:1.source_cn: 我现在就要吃，我受够了！给，这几条鱼给你们，保住力气再...

say:12:1622417012:1.text: Bur downs a small fish, and the flock around him follows suit. But he doesn't reach for another; instead, he looks toward those still standing with Serka.
say:12:1622417012:1.source_cn: 布尔叼起一条小鱼吞下，随即它身旁的候鸟开始狼吞虎咽。但...

say:13:1622417013:1.text: Are you seriously choosing hunger? Come on. Eat a little. You're injured; this can turn bad fast.
say:13:1622417013:1.source_cn: 你们几个……也要陪它挨饿吗？吃点吧，伤这么重，再不吃会...

say:14:1622417014:2.text: They hesitate... before lowering their heads and pecking at the fish in silence.
say:14:1622417014:2.source_cn: 瑟卡身旁的几只候鸟犹豫片刻，最终还是低下头，默默啄食小鱼。

say:17:1622417016:0.text: A low purr rumbles from nearby. Sleek wildcats step from the shadows, circling until the flock has nowhere left to run.
say:17:1622417016:0.source_cn: 这时，不远处传来一阵低沉的呼噜声，几只身形矫健的野猫从...

say:20:1622417017:0.text: Well, well... What are you sorry little strays doing in our woods?
say:20:1622417017:0.source_cn: 啧啧……你们这群落魄的家伙，是从哪冒出来的？

say:21:1622417018:0.text: Chirp-chirp! We're victims of the storm. We mean no harm!
say:21:1622417018:0.source_cn: 啾啾啾！各位猫大人！我们只是因风暴而落难在此，没有恶意。

say:22:1622417019:1.text: And these fish are all from a human girl. Fat and tasty, I swear!
say:22:1622417019:1.source_cn: 您看，这些鱼都是一个人类女孩送的，味道很是鲜美！

say:23:1622417020:1.text: She's the generous sort. More fish will come. And when it does... we'd be honored if you accepted it.
say:23:1622417020:1.source_cn: 那个人类女孩看起来热心善良，肯定还会继续送食物过来，到...

say:24:1622417021:1.text: Just one request... give us a corner to build a nest and rest. We'll stay out of your way.
say:24:1622417021:1.source_cn: 我们唯一有个小小的请求……希望能在这片宝地筑个巢，休整...

say:26:1622417022:0.text: Build a nest? Are you out of your mind, Bur? The lead bird hasn't said a word!
say:26:1622417022:0.source_cn: 筑巢？布尔，你疯了吗？！这是头鸟的决定吗？

say:27:1622417023:1.text: We move with the season. We are flying south! You want to stop and nest like we belong here?
say:27:1622417023:1.source_cn: 我们是候鸟！季节在召唤，我们必须继续向南迁徙！怎么能留...

say:29:1622417024:0.text: Silentwood isn't an inn where strangers can come and go as they wish. We have rules, meow!
say:29:1622417024:0.source_cn: 禁语森林可不是什么外来户都能随便安家的。规矩，懂吗？喵呜！

say:30:1622417025:0.text: Chirp... Rules, of course! And we can offer something back—food, favors, whatever you want. We just need a corner to rest.
say:30:1622417025:0.source_cn: 啾……规矩我们懂，有人类朋友帮忙，我们也会努力报答各位...

say:31:1622417026:0.text: Save it. Pets who live off humans don't get to negotiate with us.
say:31:1622417026:0.source_cn: 行了行了，依附人类的软骨头！也配跟我们谈条件？

say:33:1622417028:0.text: We survive and conquer the sky with our wings! Who made you our judges?
say:33:1622417028:0.source_cn: 候鸟靠翅膀征服天空，按自己的意志生存！什么时候轮到你们...

say:34:1622417029:0.text: Funny, coming from cats who play sweet for humans and purr for food.
say:34:1622417029:0.source_cn: 我倒是听说，有些猫总在人类面前卖弄可爱！出卖自己的肚皮...

say:36:1622417030:0.text: Mrrrow! We're natural hunters and hunters don't depend on anyone! I will make you regret it!
say:36:1622417030:0.source_cn: 喵呜！你知不知道自己在和谁说话？我们是天生的猎手，什么...

say:38:1622417031:0.text: I'm going to eat you alive!

say:40:1622417032:1.text: Tension snaps tight. The cats arch their backs, ready to spring.
say:40:1622417032:1.source_cn: 气氛骤然紧张，猫咪们弓起身子，作势欲扑。

say:41:1622417033:1.text: Cassadee wants to rush in, only to be stopped by Hepler. Still, the branch rustles.
say:41:1622417033:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂焦急地想要上前，被赫普急忙拦下。但两人的动作还是...

say:1:1622419001:1.text: Hepler reveals himself as a massive owlbear. The cats recoil instantly, ears flat, paws sliding backward.
say:1:1622419001:1.source_cn: 赫普以枭熊的威严样貌现身，野猫们顿时露出惊恐之色，齐齐后退。

say:3:1622419002:0.text: I-It was a routine inspection! To keep intruders under watch... We didn't know you were here, Lord <style="highlight">Woodkeeper</style>. Our apologies!
say:3:1622419002:0.source_cn: 我、我们只是例行巡查，怕有外来者破坏森林的秩序……不知...

say:4:1622419003:0.text: Forgive us. We'll be gone immediately...
say:4:1622419003:0.source_cn: 是、是我们冒犯了，我们……我们这就走……

say:7:1622419004:0.text: Hepler says nothing. He simply watches as the cats scatter into the trees. Awestruck, the flock looks at him.
say:7:1622419004:0.source_cn: 赫普沉默未语，目送猫群仓皇散去，消失在林间。在场的候鸟...

say:9:1622419005:1.text: Chirp! What a lifesaver! Thank you!
say:9:1622419005:1.source_cn: 啾！是您帮了我们！太感谢了！您真是我们的大恩人！

say:14:1622419008:1.source_cn: 那是一个强大而神秘的……

say:15:1622419009:1.text: Serka is cut off as a bird comes flapping in.
say:15:1622419009:1.source_cn: 瑟卡还未说完，一只候鸟惊慌失措地向你们飞来。
say:15:1622419009:1.male: Serka is cut off as a bird comes flapping in.
say:15:1622419009:1.female: Serka is cut off as a bird comes flapping in.

say:17:1622419010:1.text: Bad news! Serka! One of the chicks bolted when that happened. It's gone!
say:17:1622419010:1.source_cn: 不好了！瑟卡！刚才的动静把几只幼鸟吓散了，现在不知道飞...

say:19:1622419012:1.source_cn: 瑟卡刚迈出一步，便因翅膀的伤势踉跄了一下，显然已无力飞行。

say:23:1622419013:1.source_cn: 赫普向你微微颔首，表示赞同。

say:2:1622434302:1.source_cn: 不行！要么一起飞走，要么一起留下！鸟群是一个整体！

say:3:1622434303:1.text: Chirp... One of us takes the cost. That's what being one flock means. Go!
say:3:1622434303:1.source_cn: 啾……正因为是一个整体，才需要有鸟承担错误！快走！

say:0:1622434401:1.text: The beasts keep coming and the flock starts to break.
say:0:1622434401:1.source_cn: 野兽群聚，数量越来越多，鸟群渐渐不支。

say:2:1622434402:0.text: Bur's going to sacrifice himself! Let's move, or it'll be too late!
say:2:1622434402:0.source_cn: 梅林大人！布尔它……它要牺牲自己！我们再不出手，就真的...
say:2:1622434402:0.male: Bur's going to sacrifice himself! Let's move, or it'll be too late!
say:2:1622434402:0.female: Bur's going to sacrifice himself! Let's move, or it'll be too late!

choice_prompt:3:1622434402.text: Bur's going to sacrifice himself! Let's move, or it'll be too late!
choice_prompt:3:1622434402.source_cn: 梅林大人！布尔它……它要牺牲自己！我们再不出手，就真的来不及了！
choice_prompt:3:1622434402.male: Bur's going to sacrifice himself! Let's move, or it'll be too late!
choice_prompt:3:1622434402.female: Bur's going to sacrifice himself! Let's move, or it'll be too late!

say:4:1622434403:1.text: Cassadee wiggles frantically. Just as she is about to break free...
say:4:1622434403:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂满心焦急，她几乎要挣脱开你的控制……
say:4:1622434403:1.male: Cassadee wiggles frantically. Just as she is about to break free...
say:4:1622434403:1.female: Cassadee wiggles frantically. Just as she is about to break free...

narration:5:1622434404:1.text: A deep roar rolls out from the heart of the forest.

say:1:1622436001:0.text: Professor Hepler?! Y-You didn't go back to the academy?
say:1:1622436001:0.source_cn: 赫普老师，您……您没回学院？

say:2:1622436002:1.text: I knew you wouldn't leave the flock behind.
say:2:1622436002:1.source_cn: 我就知道你一定还是放心不下这些候鸟。

say:3:1622436003:1.text: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Why are you here?
say:3:1622436003:1.male: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Why are you here?
say:3:1622436003:1.female: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Why are you here?

choice_prompt:4:1622436003.text: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Why are you here?
choice_prompt:4:1622436003.male: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Why are you here?
choice_prompt:4:1622436003.female: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Why are you here?

say:6:1622436004:1.text: Before Hepler can say more, Serka flies straight to him. He bows his head with respect, pleading.
say:6:1622436004:1.source_cn: 赫普尚未开口，瑟卡迅速飞到他的面前，语气充满敬畏与恳求。

say:8:1622436005:1.text: You really are Lord Woodkeeper! Father told me stories about you!
say:8:1622436005:1.source_cn: 林息者大人！您果然是林息者大人！我从父亲那里听说过关于...

say:9:1622436006:1.text: He said, something powerful secretly dwells in the woods near the Serene Lyceum.
say:9:1622436006:1.source_cn: 父亲说，在莱希拉姆附近的森林中，栖息着一位神秘而强大的存在。

say:10:1622436007:1.text: On bright days, he sits on an old sunstone perfectly still, locked in a silent contest with the sun itself.
say:10:1622436007:1.source_cn: 每当天气晴朗时，他总会端坐在一块古老的日光石上一动不动...

say:11:1622436008:1.text: When the sun finally relents, he drinks in the blazing light that pours down and turns it into boundless power.
say:11:1622436008:1.source_cn: 直到胜利后，将倾泻而下的炽热阳光吸收，化为无穷无尽的魔力。

choice_prompt:12:1622436008.text: When the sun finally relents, he drinks in the blazing light that pours down and turns it into boundless power.
choice_prompt:12:1622436008.source_cn: 直到胜利后，将倾泻而下的炽热阳光吸收，化为无穷无尽的魔力。

say:13:1622436009:1.text: No, Lord Wolf, if you'll forgive my bluntness... perhaps your senses simply can't grasp the Woodkeeper's blazing, overflowing magic.
say:13:1622436009:1.source_cn: 不，狼阁下，恕我直言，也许是您的力量有限，无法感知到林...
say:13:1622436009:1.male: No, Lord Wolf, if you'll forgive my bluntness... perhaps your senses simply can't grasp the Woodkeeper's blazing, overflowing magic.
say:13:1622436009:1.female: No, Lord Wolf, if you'll forgive my bluntness... perhaps your senses simply can't grasp the Woodkeeper's blazing, overflowing magic.

say:14:1622436010:1.text: Any creature can enjoy the sun. But none of them can sit perfectly still beneath it... until sunset. No one except Lord Woodkeeper!
say:14:1622436010:1.source_cn: 其他任何爱晒太阳的生物，都不会在阳光下保持静止，直到太...
say:14:1622436010:1.male: Any creature can enjoy the sun. But none of them can sit perfectly still beneath it... until sunset. No one except Lord Woodkeeper!
say:14:1622436010:1.female: Any creature can enjoy the sun. But none of them can sit perfectly still beneath it... until sunset. No one except Lord Woodkeeper!

say:15:1622436012:1.text: We pray for the Woodkeeper's blessing when passing by the Silentwood during migration seasons. It's a sign of safe skies ahead.
say:15:1622436012:1.source_cn: 每年迁徙季节，当鸟群途经禁语森林时，都期盼能得到林息者...

say:16:1622436013:1.text: Lord Woodkeeper, I-I understand why you don't heal the lead bird. All I ask is a blessing from you. For the entire flock. Please.
say:16:1622436013:1.source_cn: 林息者大人，我知道……我知道您不会为头鸟治疗。但能不能...

say:18:1622436014:1.text: A young bird bursts in, frantic, voice cracking.
say:18:1622436014:1.source_cn: 就在这时，一只年轻的候鸟惊慌失措地飞来，声音凄厉。

say:19:1622436015:1.text: Coo—coo—! Our lead bird... H-He tried to protect the chicks from the monsters, b-but...
say:19:1622436015:1.source_cn: 咕咕咕！头鸟它……它刚才为了保护幼鸟，被那些坏家伙给…...

say:21:1622436016:1.text: The words cut through the flock like winter wind. An unsettling silence. Serka stands frozen.
say:21:1622436016:1.source_cn: 消息如寒风般刮过鸟群，一片死寂，瑟卡呆立在原地。

say:22:1622436017:1.text: Cries and panicked calls follow a beat later.
say:22:1622436017:1.source_cn: 片刻后，鸟群陷入骚动，哀鸣此起彼伏。

say:24:1622436018:0.text: The lead bird is dead... The path memory is gone...
say:24:1622436018:0.source_cn: 头鸟死了……路径记忆不见了……

say:26:1622436019:0.text: We'll never reach the south again...
say:26:1622436019:0.source_cn: 我们再也到不了南边了……

say:28:1622436020:0.text: Wh-What do we do...? Are we trapped in this forest forever?
say:28:1622436020:0.source_cn: 怎么办……我们要在森林里待一辈子吗？

say:31:1622436022:1.text: Bur scans the flock. His gaze finally lands on Serka, head bowed.
say:31:1622436022:1.source_cn: 布尔环视众鸟，目光最后落在沉默低头的瑟卡身上。

say:32:1622436023:1.text: I know you're grieving. I know you're afraid. But the one who's hurting most... is Serka.
say:32:1622436023:1.source_cn: 我知道大家都很难过、害怕，但此刻最悲伤的，是瑟卡。

say:33:1622436024:1.text: The lead bird... was his father...
say:33:1622436024:1.source_cn: 啾……逝去的头鸟……是瑟卡的父亲。

say:35:1622436025:1.text: Every eye turns to Serka. He keeps his head down in silence. The grief hits him like a deadly blow, shattering something inside him.
say:35:1622436025:1.source_cn: 所有候鸟的目光都聚焦在瑟卡身上，它低着头，一言不发，突...

say:37:1622436026:0.text: Lord Woodkeeper, Lord Wolves... I want to hold a funeral for the lead bird.
say:37:1622436026:0.source_cn: 啾啾……林息者大人，两位狼阁下，还有大家……我想为老头...

say:42:1622436028:1.text: Yes. He will be free like the wind, unburdened by flesh.
say:42:1622436028:1.source_cn: 当然，它将如大风般自由，脱离躯壳的重负，回归天空。

narration:43:1622436029:1.text: With Hepler's low, ancient chant humming, you and the flock lay the fallen lead bird to rest...
narration:43:1622436029:1.male: With Hepler's low, ancient chant humming, you and the flock lay the fallen lead bird to rest...
narration:43:1622436029:1.female: With Hepler's low, ancient chant humming, you and the flock lay the fallen lead bird to rest...

choice:40:0:1.source_cn: 老头鸟值得一场庄严的告别

say:45:1622436011:1.text: Could it be... there is more than one Woodkeeper? No, no, you're only enjoying the heat, like the rest of us, Lord Wolf. But the Woodkeeper? He is fighting it!
say:45:1622436011:1.source_cn: 难道……不止一位林息者大人？不对，狼阁下，您和我们鸟群...
say:45:1622436011:1.male: Could it be... there is more than one Woodkeeper? No, no, you're only enjoying the heat, like the rest of us, Lord Wolf. But the Woodkeeper? He is fighting it!
say:45:1622436011:1.female: Could it be... there is more than one Woodkeeper? No, no, you're only enjoying the heat, like the rest of us, Lord Wolf. But the Woodkeeper? He is fighting it!

choice:4:2:3.text: You have to see it to get it.
choice:4:2:3.source_cn: 有些事需要亲眼看看才能理解
choice:4:2:3.male: You have to see it to get it.
choice:4:2:3.female: You have to see it to get it.

say:0:1622438001:0.text: I had no idea they were family. He's probably hurting more than anyone.
say:0:1622438001:0.source_cn: 没想到瑟卡是老头鸟的孩子，它现在一定很难过吧。

say:1:1622438002:0.text: Let's check on him. Even a little comfort might help right now.
say:1:1622438002:0.source_cn: 也许我们的安慰会让它感到好受一些，我们去看看它吧。
say:1:1622438002:0.male: Let's check on him. Even a little comfort might help right now.
say:1:1622438002:0.female: Let's check on him. Even a little comfort might help right now.

say:1:1622439001:1.text: Lord Woodkeeper, Lord Wolves, thank you. Now my father has gone back to the sky with a fighter's pride.
say:1:1622439001:1.source_cn: 林息者大人，还有二位狼阁下，谢谢你们，让父亲……能以战...
say:1:1622439001:1.male: Lord Woodkeeper, Lord Wolves, thank you. Now my father has gone back to the sky with a fighter's pride.
say:1:1622439001:1.female: Lord Woodkeeper, Lord Wolves, thank you. Now my father has gone back to the sky with a fighter's pride.

say:2:1622439002:1.text: He'll... rest now. I know he will.
say:2:1622439002:1.source_cn: 我父亲……它一定会安息的。

say:4:1622439003:1.text: Serka, I'm so sorry... It's all my fault... I let the smell of fish and the illusion of comfort cloud my head, and I dragged the whole flock with me...
say:4:1622439003:1.source_cn: 瑟卡，对不起……这一切都是我的错……我……是我被鱼的香...

say:5:1622439004:1.text: Death doesn't scare me. I-I fear struggle. But we aren't born to settle. There's no land for us.
say:5:1622439004:1.source_cn: 我不怕死……但我就怕、怕不安逸……候鸟的爪子，不属于任...

say:6:1622439005:1.text: I'm sorry. I nearly led the whole flock straight into a grave.
say:6:1622439005:1.source_cn: 对不起，大家，差点将你们带入绝境！

choice_prompt:7:1622439005.text: I'm sorry. I nearly led the whole flock straight into a grave.
choice_prompt:7:1622439005.source_cn: 对不起，大家，差点将你们带入绝境！

say:8:1622439006:1.text: I have an idea. I just hope it isn't too late.
say:8:1622439006:1.source_cn: 我、我现在有一个想法，希望不会太晚。

say:9:1622439007:1.text: Bur looks around at the quiet birds until his gaze locks onto Serka with determination.
say:9:1622439007:1.source_cn: 布尔抬起头，目光扫过周围沉默的鸟群，最后坚定地落在瑟卡身上。

say:10:1622439008:1.text: The beasts only backed off for now; they're still lurking in the dark. We can't live forever under Lord Woodkeeper's protection.
say:10:1622439008:1.source_cn: 野兽虽然退走了，但它们的眼睛还在暗处发光！我们总不能永...

say:11:1622439009:1.text: We have to fly. But <style="highlight">a flock can't depart with a lead bird</style>!

say:12:1622439010:1.text: Serka, when hunger hit hardest, you didn't break. You faced the wildcats and beasts head-on. We all saw it.
say:12:1622439010:1.source_cn: 瑟卡，你在最饥饿的时候也没有动摇，大家都看到了你面对那...

say:13:1622439011:1.text: And no one in the flock flies better than you do!
say:13:1622439011:1.source_cn: 你的飞行技术，更是我们当中最出色的那只！

say:14:1622439012:1.text: We need you to be our lead bird. To lead us forward. I will follow you always!
say:14:1622439012:1.source_cn: 我们需要你担任头鸟，带领大家！我布尔，愿意追随你！

say:16:1622439013:1.text: A short, heavy pause, then agreement rises in waves, gathering into one voice.
say:16:1622439013:1.source_cn: 经过短暂的寂静，几只候鸟开始附和，声音逐渐汇聚成共识。

say:18:1622439014:1.source_cn: 喳喳！瑟卡带头！咕！瑟卡做头鸟！

say:19:1622439015:0.text: No... You don't understand. Migration needs <style="highlight">path memory</style>!
say:19:1622439015:0.source_cn: 不……不！布尔，大家……你们不明白！迁徙需要<styl...

say:20:1622439016:1.text: We need it to pick the best route. The one with shelter along the way, the least danger around, so we can make it to the warm lands intact.
say:20:1622439016:1.source_cn: 只有依靠路径记忆，我们才能找到途中可以停歇的绿洲、避开...

say:21:1622439017:1.text: Father was the one who carried it! I don't know any of it! I'll lead everyone into a dead end. I can't do it!
say:21:1622439017:1.source_cn: 这些……这些只有父亲才知道！我什么都不知道！我会把大家...

say:23:1622439018:1.text: What makes a lead bird strong, Serka? Memorizing a perfect route? No.
say:23:1622439018:1.source_cn: 瑟卡，你认为，头鸟最强大的力量，是它脑中那幅完美无缺的...

say:24:1622439019:1.text: A map doesn't lead a flock. A wise leader does, through judgement and the ability to keep a whole flock as one.
say:24:1622439019:1.source_cn: 头鸟的核心力量，从来不是提供死记硬背的地图，而是在于决...

say:25:1622439020:1.text: It's a strength to decide when the storm hits. To shield everyone when danger closes in. To pull everyone back into one when the flock begins to fracture.
say:25:1622439020:1.source_cn: 是在风暴来临时做出决断，在危险前守护族群，是在内部产生...

say:26:1622439021:1.text: Yes, the path memory is precious, but it isn't a law carved in stone. It's a route updated in flight again and again by every generation of lead birds.
say:26:1622439021:1.source_cn: 路径记忆确实珍贵，但它并非刻在石板上的永恒律法。它是在...

say:27:1622439022:1.text: <style="highlight">When a lead bird falls, a new one rises. In future flight, you will rebuild the memory that works for you.</style>

say:28:1622439023:1.text: This is the moment. Your next flight is where the new memory starts.
say:28:1622439023:1.source_cn: 眼前这次起飞，就是你们共同书写新记忆的最佳时机。

say:29:1622439024:0.text: But... that could send us the wrong way without knowing what's ahead!
say:29:1622439024:0.source_cn: 可是……林息者大人，这意味着可能飞向错误的方向，面对无...

say:30:1622439025:1.text: I'll pay for my choice, even with my life. But how many will fall before we find the way again? That weight is unbearable...
say:30:1622439025:1.source_cn: 我愿意为自己的选择付出代价，哪怕是生命！但我怎么能……...

say:31:1622439026:1.text: The choice belongs to all of you. Hear what your flock will say.
say:31:1622439026:1.source_cn: 抉择的权力，来自于族群的共同意志，你不妨听听大家的声音。

choice_prompt:32:1622439026.text: The choice belongs to all of you. Hear what your flock will say.
choice_prompt:32:1622439026.source_cn: 抉择的权力，来自于族群的共同意志，你不妨听听大家的声音。

say:34:1622439028:0.text: Mm-hm! Serka will be a great lead bird!
say:34:1622439028:0.source_cn: 嗯！我相信瑟卡先生一定能做好头鸟！

say:36:1622439029:1.text: Bur turns to the flock as he takes a deep breath. This time he isn't trying to please anyone or win an argument. He speaks to light a fire.
say:36:1622439029:1.source_cn: 布尔深吸一口气，转向候鸟群，声音不再是为了讨好或争辩，...

say:38:1622439030:1.text: Tell me! What are our wings for?
say:38:1622439030:1.source_cn: 大声告诉我！我们的翅膀生来是为了什么？

say:39:1622439031:1.text: We belong to the sky! Chirp!
say:39:1622439031:1.source_cn: 啾……咕咕……候鸟属于天空！叽喳！

say:40:1622439032:1.text: Exactly! Our wings are new again, ready for a hard flap!
say:40:1622439032:1.source_cn: 没错！看看我们新生的正羽！它在等待下一次有力的扇动！

say:41:1622439033:1.text: <style="highlight">Fear of predators keeps us alive, while fear of the sky kills us.</style>

say:42:1622439034:1.text: I swear on my wings and my life! I follow Serka until my wings fail!
say:42:1622439034:1.source_cn: 用我的翅膀和生命保证，我将追随瑟卡！直到坠入谷壑的那一刻。

say:44:1622439036:1.text: I hear you... Chirp! I'll be the lead bird!
say:44:1622439036:1.source_cn: 大家……啾……好！我愿意担起这份责任！

say:45:1622439037:1.text: After you left, Lord Woodkeeper, I remembered our <style="highlight">ancestors' words: When the north wind howls, spread your wings and go south.</style>
say:45:1622439037:1.source_cn: 可是，还有一个问题……林息者大人，上次您走后，我回忆起...

say:46:1622439038:1.text: But there's one problem... the monsoon season has already passed. There is no north wind strong enough to lift the entire flock.
say:46:1622439038:1.source_cn: 但今年的季风已过，哪里还有能托起我们整个族群的强大北风呢？

say:48:1622439039:1.text: Hepler slowly raises an arm. The air responds to his magic, circling to form a strong wind.
say:48:1622439039:1.source_cn: 就在这时，赫普缓缓抬起手臂，周围的气流伴随着魔法的光辉...

say:53:1622439041:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，赫普老师，我也来帮忙！

narration:54:1622439042:1.text: The three of you undo your transfigurations and pour magic into the wind.
narration:54:1622439042:1.male: The three of you undo your transfigurations and pour magic into the wind.
narration:54:1622439042:1.female: The three of you undo your transfigurations and pour magic into the wind.

narration:55:1622439043:1.text: The wind rises. It sweeps leaves into the air, races through the woods, and then carries the flock upward...

say:57:1622439027:1.text: You can... fly too, Lord Wolf?
say:57:1622439027:1.source_cn: 狼阁下，难道您……您也会飞行？
say:57:1622439027:1.male: You can... fly too, Lord Wolf?
say:57:1622439027:1.female: You can... fly too, Lord Wolf?

choice_prompt:58:1622439027.text: You can... fly too, Lord Wolf?
choice_prompt:58:1622439027.source_cn: 狼阁下，难道您……您也会飞行？
choice_prompt:58:1622439027.male: You can... fly too, Lord Wolf?
choice_prompt:58:1622439027.female: You can... fly too, Lord Wolf?

choice:58:0:1.text: Just a joke. I believe in you.
choice:58:0:1.source_cn: 开个玩笑，我看好你做头鸟
choice:58:0:1.male: Just a joke. I believe in you.
choice:58:0:1.female: Just a joke. I believe in you.

choice:7:0:1.text: Owning your mistake is a start.
choice:7:0:1.male: Owning your mistake is a start.
choice:7:0:1.female: Owning your mistake is a start.

say:3:1622441001:1.text: Chirp! The north wind is coming! When the north wind howls, spread your wings!
say:3:1622441001:1.source_cn: 啾咕咕……北风！是北风！北风呼啸之时，张开你的翅膀！

say:5:1622441002:1.text: It's warm yet strong. Our ancestors heard our courage! Thank you, Lord Woodkeeper!
say:5:1622441002:1.source_cn: 这风……温暖而有力，一定是先祖回应了我们的勇气！感谢您...

say:7:1622441003:1.text: Hope didn't come from your ancestors or me. It came from the courage you found when you had nothing left... and the wings you were born with.
say:7:1622441003:1.source_cn: 给予你们希望的不是先祖或我，而是你们自己在绝境中唤醒的...

say:8:1622441004:1.text: The north wind was born in the woods. I only stirred it awake.
say:8:1622441004:1.source_cn: 这股北风，本就孕育于这片森林的呼吸，我只是提前将它唤醒。

say:9:1622441005:1.text: Fly on. Go south and build a sweet home there.
say:9:1622441005:1.source_cn: 飞吧，去南方建立你们的冬季家园。

choice_prompt:10:1622441005.text: Fly on. Go south and build a sweet home there.
choice_prompt:10:1622441005.source_cn: 飞吧，去南方建立你们的冬季家园。

say:11:1622441006:0.text: Mm. Hope we meet again when the spring wind rises!
say:11:1622441006:0.source_cn: 嗯！三位，希望来年春风时，我们能再次相遇！

narration:12:1622441007:0.text: Carried by the roaring north wind, the flock lifts as one and flies toward the south.
narration:12:1622441007:0.source_cn: 在强劲的北风助力下，候鸟群振翅而起，坚定地飞向南方天际。

say:5:1622442002:1.text: I can't wait to see them again next spring.
say:5:1622442002:1.source_cn: 嗯！真期待明年春天和它们再次相见！

say:6:1622442004:1.text: Cassadee doesn't look away until the last bird melts into the sky.
say:6:1622442004:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂久久凝望天空，直到最后一只候鸟也消失在云层中。

say:8:1622442005:1.text: Professor Hepler... The north wind—you didn't just mean the spell, did you?
say:8:1622442005:1.source_cn: 赫普老师，您说的北风……指的不仅是那股魔法风暴，对吗？

say:9:1622442006:1.text: The north wind gives them the push at the moment that matters, but it doesn't fly for them.
say:9:1622442006:1.source_cn: 北风是在关键时刻推他们一把的力量，但不是替他们飞行。

say:10:1622442007:1.text: I thought help meant feeding, patching wounds, preventing every loss... Turned out that it almost smothered their nature.
say:10:1622442007:1.source_cn: 我之前一直在喂食、治疗，想让他们不受任何伤害……这就像...

say:11:1622442008:1.text: Being a north wind at the moment they prepare to fly is actually the best help one can give.
say:11:1622442008:1.source_cn: 但……真正的帮助，应该是在他们准备好起飞时，给予那临门...

say:12:1622442009:1.text: When you're in the court, in that tangle of politics, I hope you remember this, Cassadee.
say:12:1622442009:1.source_cn: 当你去了宫廷，面对那些出身高贵的同僚和复杂的局势时，科...

say:13:1622442010:1.text: Cassadee answers before Hepler can finish, calm and certain.
say:13:1622442010:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂接上了赫普的话，语气坚定。

say:14:1622442011:1.text: I don't need an umbrella over my head, but a steady north wind at my back when it matters.
say:14:1622442011:1.source_cn: 我需要的不是大家时刻在身边为我遮风挡雨，而是像今天这股...

say:15:1622442012:1.text: We gave them the north wind, but it would've been wasted if they didn't choose the sky.
say:15:1622442012:1.source_cn: 就像候鸟一样，尽管梅林大人和赫普老师为它们提供了北风，...
say:15:1622442012:1.male: We gave them the north wind, but it would've been wasted if they didn't choose the sky.
say:15:1622442012:1.female: We gave them the north wind, but it would've been wasted if they didn't choose the sky.

say:17:1622442013:1.text: Cassadee looks out at the clear sky. The flock is gone. In its place, the dusk creates a golden route that stretches all the way into the horizon.
say:17:1622442013:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂看向远方天空，那里已经空无一鸟，但晚霞正在铺开一...

say:19:1622442014:1.text: Cassadee, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I won't be the lead bird that charts your route. But there will always be a north wind lifting you.
say:19:1622442014:1.male: Cassadee, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I won't be the lead bird that charts your route. But there will always be a north wind lifting you.
say:19:1622442014:1.female: Cassadee, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I won't be the lead bird that charts your route. But there will always be a north wind lifting you.

say:20:1622442015:1.text: As long as you are ready to soar.
say:20:1622442015:1.source_cn: 只要你已鼓足冲向云霄的勇气。

say:24:1622442003:1.text: They'll survive the freeze, the wind, all of it and reach their southern home.
say:24:1622442003:1.source_cn: 嗯！它们一定能穿越风暴与严寒，顺利抵达温暖的南方家园！

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 希望它们能顺利到达南方

cinematic_dialogue:1:1622416001:.text: It's perfect here. Any closer and they'll spook.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1622416001:.source_cn: 就在这里吧，再近就会引起警觉

cinematic_dialogue:1:1622416002:.text: Let's use transfiguration and hear what they're saying.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1622416002:.source_cn: 用变形术，听听它们真实的声音

cinematic_dialogue:1:1622416003:.source_cn: 不要暴露与干涉，观察即可

cinematic_dialogue:1:1622437002:.text: May your soul find its way home to the horizon.
